query: SELECT LPAD(TO_VARCHAR(CIK),10,'0') || '|' || COMPANY_NAME || '|' || LISTAGG(DISTINCT FILING_TYPE, '+') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FILING_TYPE) || '|' || TO_VARCHAR(MIN(DATE_FILED)) || '|' || TO_VARCHAR(MAX(DATE_FILED)) || '|' || TO_VARCHAR(COUNT(*)) AS r FROM DBT_STAGING_EDGAR.STG_EDGAR_BDC_ELECTION_INDEX GROUP BY CIK, COMPANY_NAME ORDER BY CIK, COMPANY_NAME

byte_check.method: MD5 over the 609 pipe-delimited rows joined by a single newline, no trailing newline, in (CIK, COMPANY_NAME) order
